meta.title: Kartos — a home for your family's memory
meta.description: Family tree, grave map and photo archive in one private place. Build it together with your relatives.

hero.title: One place to remember everyone
hero.lead: Gather your family's history into one private archive: who was who, where each person rests, the old photographs, and the stories worth keeping for your children.
hero.note: Free. Only your family can see what you add.

sample.name: Ona Jankauskienė
sample.memory: “She baked apple cake every Sunday and never once gave away the recipe.”
sample.directions: By the birch, third row from the chapel

keep.title: What you'll keep
keep.lead: The three things most often lost between generations.

tree.title: Family tree
tree.body: Parents, grandparents, children, spouses and second marriages. The tree grows as more relatives join.

map.title: Grave map
map.body: The exact grave, its section and row, and a note on how to find it. Every family grave on one map.

archive.title: Photos and memories
archive.body: Old photographs, letters, documents and stories, linked to the people and years they belong to.

steps.title: Your first person in a minute
steps.lead: No genealogy knowledge needed. Start with one person.

two.title: Add someone you want to remember
two.body: A name is enough. Dates, a photo and the grave can come later.

three.title: Invite your relatives
three.body: Share a link by Messenger, WhatsApp or email. Everyone adds what they know.

visit.title: When it's time to visit, every family grave is on one map
visit.body: Younger relatives no longer have to ask where their great-grandparents rest. Open the map, choose the grave, and get directions to it.

privacy.title: Your family's history belongs to you

items.title: Private by default
items.body: Only invited family members can see anything. Nothing is ever published automatically.

items.title: Living relatives protected
items.body: Dates, photos and places of living people are never shown publicly.

items.title: Export any time
items.body: Download all your data and photos, even if you stop using the service.

items.title: Never held hostage
items.body: Paid features only add to what you have. Your archive is never locked.

final.title: Start with one name
final.body: The rest follows: photos, dates, stories, and the relatives who know more.

footer.tagline: A family memory archive. Made in Klaipėda.

login.title: Sign in

login.terms: By signing in you agree to the terms of use and privacy policy.
login.linkError: The sign-in link has expired or was opened in a different browser. Request a new one.
login.rateLimit: Too many emails in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
